units.source_text: “我在老家还有一个上学的孩子。

en.t: I have a child back home who is still going to school.

units.source_text: 现在想起来了，你这身衣服的花纹，同我孩子那身碎白花纹是一模一样的。

en.t: Now that I think of it, the pattern on your clothes is exactly the same as the little white floral pattern on my child's outfit.

units.source_text: 最近藏青碎白花纹布好贵，真难为我们啊。”

en.t: Lately, navy-blue cloth with little white flowers has become so expensive; it really makes things hard for us.
